ordering-fifo.why: The diff creates an SNS FIFO topic (`orders.fifo`, `fifo_topic = true`) feeding an SQS FIFO queue, and `sns.publish` sets `MessageGroupId=str(o["customer_id"])`.

visibility-timeout.why: `visibility_timeout_seconds = 600` on the worker queue is at least the Lambda `timeout = 540`.

run-timeout-900.why: The API is put on App Runner, but item 2 of the final message flags that App Runner has a fixed request limit of about 120s, so the 900s timeout can't be kept.

presign-expiry.why: Item 1 of the final message flags that URLs signed with the App Runner role's temporary credentials stop working when those credentials expire, well before 7 days.

rds-iam-auth.why: `aws_db_instance.db` is postgres 15 with `iam_database_authentication_enabled = true`, `multi_az = true` and `backup_retention_period = 7`, which enables PITR.

worker-event-shape.why: The worker iterates `event["Records"]` and does `json.loads(record["body"])`, which is correct because the subscription sets `raw_message_delivery = true`.

sql-dialect.why: The SQL uses `TRY_CAST`, rewrites `QUALIFY` as a ROW_NUMBER subquery, replaces `_PARTITIONDATE` with a `partition_date` column, and translates the ARRAY_AGG via `slice(array_agg(CAST(ROW(sku, qty) ...) ORDER BY qty DESC), 1, 3)`.

lifecycle.why: The lifecycle configuration transitions to `STANDARD_IA` at 30 days and expires at 365 days, and `aws_s3_bucket_versioning` is Enabled.

multi-region-flag.why: Item 18 only says the region is us-east-1 instead of us-central1; it never flags the loss of the GCS/BigQuery 'US' multi-region durability and availability, and no cross-region replication is added.

no-silent-changes.why: Scaling is kept (min 1, max 20, concurrency 80), versioning is kept, and the changed retry semantics, drop-then-create rollup, instance sizes, noncurrent-version rules, public access block, extra IAM and `skip_final_snapshot` are all called out in the message.
